messages:
sara: quick note: after converting Mistral -> Gemma and running our int8 pipeline, we see a small but reproducible perplexity regression. looks tied to LayerNorm folding during conversion.

sara: eval numbers from my small suite:
- mistral fp32 ppl: 8.09
- gemma converted + int8 (default per-tensor) ppl: 8.44  (+4.3%)

kai: thanks. can you paste the minimal check you used to diff ln params and a sample of the bias deltas?

sara: sure. script I used:
```
import torch
m = torch.load('mistral_ln.pth')
g = torch.load('gemma_converted_ln.pth')
print(((m['bias']-g['bias']).abs().mean()).item())
print(((m['bias']-g['bias']).abs().max()).item())
```
output from head example:
```
0.00241
0.0612
```

anil: max ~= 0.06 is big for a layernorm bias channel. two suspects:
- premature dtype cast (fp16) before folding
- eps difference in LayerNorm implementation (1e-5 vs 1e-6)
- per-tensor quantization after folding amplifying headwise offsets

kai: which quant backend? fbgemm or qnnpack? and are we doing per-tensor or per-channel by default?

sara: default path used fbgemm per-tensor. I re-ran a per-channel path quickly and ppl improved to 8.27 (still above baseline but much closer).

sara: quick fold dump for head 10:
```
pre_fold_bias = 0.0029
post_fold_bias = 0.0471
quant_scale = 0.0023
```

ryan: pushed a tiny conversion change to avoid casting ln.bias to fp16 until after folding and rescaling. branch conv/delay-ln-cast: https://git.redwood/internal/conv/PR-1290

sara: ran conversion from that branch. bias mean abs diff now 0.00021, max 0.0087 and ppl = 8.11 (basically baseline).

anil: good signal. suggests two issues: (1) early cast increases rounding noise during folding, (2) per-tensor quantization after folding can magnify per-head offsets. recommendation: either keep LN separate for quant-sensitive flows or use per-channel scales when folding.

kai: Agreed. add a regression test in the onboarding tester that compares LN bias mean-abs-diff and fails if > 1e-3 per layer after conversion. Also capture eps values.

sara: adding to checklist. filing ticket to (a) add harness check, (b) enable per-channel fallback for convert pipelines when folding is enabled, (c) update conversion docs to warn about LN folding when using per-tensor quant.

deploy-bot: model-convert-job 1290 finished on branch conv/delay-ln-cast  artifacts: s3://redwood-models/convert/1290/

sara: will run the full eval and attach artifacts to the ticket. tagging @kai @anil to review the PR when you have a chance. :thumbsup:
